intro: These items are published for post-publication review, not held back for approval. An official 'context only' link points to an operator or city directory but does NOT verify the specific unverified claim. Missing addresses, hours, prices and bookings are intentionally left blank.

items.title: Trip year conflicts with weekday labels
items.finding: Notes include ‘Nov 2, 2006’ while the Sunday-to-Monday sequence fits Nov 1–9, 2026. Year 2026 is used only as a working layout, not a confirmed travel date.
items.action: Confirm actual year and all nine dates before making time-sensitive plans. Nov 9 closure advice applies only if 2026 is intended.

items.title: Full original schedule is not available
items.finding: The saved repository contains no complete day-by-day source itinerary; identifiable venues and date clues survived. The displayed day assignments are an editorial proposal.
items.action: Compare with the original nine-day plan if available; do not interpret this site's ordering as a reproduced reservation or traveler instruction.

items.title: Flights and airport terminal unverified
items.finding: No airline, flight numbers, times, airports or terminal details were found. Incheon ground routes are conditional examples.
items.action: Confirm the arrival/departure airport and terminal and build a real check-in/security buffer; do not rely on the published AREX onboard time as an airport transfer total.

items.title: Named hotels are not confirmed reservations
items.finding: Stanford Myeongdong and L7 Haeundae publish addresses and check-in rules, but no traveler reservation or stay dates were supplied.
items.action: Verify hotel bookings, dates, bed setup and arrival arrangements independently.

items.title: Sunday Seoul return night is unconfirmed
items.finding: The proposed Nov 8 Busan→Seoul return depends on an unverified Seoul room. Stanford's same-day luggage policy is not an overnight-storage or room guarantee.
items.action: Confirm Sunday return accommodation or adjust return and departure route.

items.title: KTX travel is a route, not a ticket
items.finding: The Seoul–Busan rail corridor and booking channels are published, but no departure, fare, seat or purchased ticket is verified for either leg.
items.action: Check current KORAIL inventory and book suitable trains only once real travel dates are known.

items.title: Busan checkout-day baggage is unresolved
items.finding: L7 publishes an 11:00 checkout but no baggage-storage terms were verified. The optional Gamcheon hillside detour is awkward with luggage.
items.action: Ask the hotel or skip Gamcheon and head to the station with bags.

items.title: Move the Tuesday palace stop
items.finding: The palace operator lists Gyeongbokgung closed on ordinary Tuesdays; November visiting hours are 09:00–17:00, last entry 16:00.
items.action: The proposed plan places it on Monday Nov 2. Recheck any holiday exception and the actual year.

items.title: Bukchon is a residential red zone
items.finding: Tourist access to restricted streets is limited to 10:00–17:00; an evening residential photo stop is not appropriate.
items.action: Visit quietly in the afternoon and follow local signage.

items.title: Gwangjang food and retail have different Sunday rules
items.finding: Retail is listed closed Sundays; the food street is listed open all year. Their hours also differ.
items.action: If Sunday is essential, expect food street only; proposed retail browse is Tuesday.

items.title: DDP is in Dongdaemun, not Seongsu
items.finding: The operator calls it Dongdaemun Design Plaza and places it at Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Station.
items.action: Use Line 2 to Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Exit 1; keep Seongsu shopping on its own day.

items.title: Do not substitute one Rain Report branch for another
items.finding: Visit Seoul lists Rain Report Rainbow in Ikseon-dong. The separate Seongsu Rain Report Croissant site has not been verified as currently operating.
items.action: The proposed route uses the officially listed Ikseon café. Do not route to Seongsu Croissant without fresh operator confirmation.

items.title: Myeongdong Kyoja is not a verified starred restaurant
items.finding: The MICHELIN Guide lists Myeongdong Kyoja as Bib Gourmand, not Michelin-starred.
items.action: Use ‘Bib Gourmand’ in recommendations and do not claim a star.

items.title: Lotte Main lists Mon Nov 9, 2026 closed
items.finding: The operator's current branch calendar explicitly marks Nov 9 as a closure. Shinsegae Main's calendar currently does not mark that day closed.
items.action: Do not schedule Lotte Main on the proposed departure Monday; Shinsegae is a conditional alternative only if flights permit. Recheck both calendars.

items.title: MARGESHERWOOD address changed in source directories
items.finding: The current brand directory lists its Seoul flagship at 13 Yeonmujang 11-gil; an older contact page is no longer available.
items.action: Use the current official store page and reconfirm before travel.

items.title: Official sources disagree on when KTX tickets open
items.finding: KORAIL says 07:00 two months before departure; VisitKorea's train guide says tickets usually open one month before.
items.action: Prefer the current train operator and verify booking inventory before relying on the window.

items.title: Blueline operator fare pages conflict
items.finding: The operator's main fare page and Sky Capsule subpage list different two-person capsule fares. A current purchasable fare is not verified.
items.action: Leave the site price blank; use the live official booking checkout. Scenic rail tickets have not been booked.

items.title: Saturday drone show is not date-specific confirmation
items.finding: Visit Busan gives the usual winter Saturday 19:00/21:00 pattern, not a guaranteed show on Nov 7, 2026.
items.action: Check the district's live event schedule and weather cancellation on the actual visit day.

items.title: Individual venues need their own official pages
items.finding: Names in the surviving research notes were not supported by current merchant-specific official addresses, hours and prices. They are not routed as confirmed stops.
items.action: See the unverified shortlist below; keep unsupported fields blank until a business operator or public tourism listing confirms each exact location.
